task.title: P6-120: Unify needs, holdings_of_oracle and move_batch into one transaction
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 1 — Destructive actions and data integrity). Original id: P6-120. Size: M. Specs: specs/collection-api.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**`needs`, `holdings_of_oracle` and `move_batch` run in three separate transactions, so the pull decides against a snapshot the write does not hold** (was `P6-049f`). `hosted.rs:1372-1420`, `:1137-1154`, `lib.rs:1432-1437` — three independent commits. This is exactly the check-then-act window `move_holding` deliberately closed for the row path.
